[[File:Cow chathead.png|left|80px]]
'''Cows''' are a bovine [[monster]] that is often killed for their hide, and new players may find useful to train on. They are one of the first monsters new players can encounter around [[Burthorpe]]. Along with cows, players can also find [[Cow calf|cow calves]] and non-attackable [[dairy cow]]s.

When a cow dies, it drops [[raw beef]] (which gives [[Cooking]] experience when cooked), a [[cowhide]] (which players can turn into leather items for [[Crafting]] experience) and [[bones]] (which players can bury for [[Prayer]] experience), and rarely anything else. Players can make {{formatnum:{{#expr: ({{GEP|Bones}}+{{GEP|Cowhide}}+{{GEP|Raw beef}})}}}} coins per cow, providing that they sell the raw beef, cowhide, and bones from a cow, so they would make {{formatnum:{{#expr: ({{GEP|Bones}}+{{GEP|Cowhide}}+{{GEP|Raw beef}})*9}}}} coins per inventory from all drops.

[[Zanaris]], the moon of Gielinor, is the only place with talking cows. The cows of Zanaris seem to dislike the sheep as well as other players, and are apparently unaware of their ability to talk. There is also a [[windmill]] that is powered by a cow in lieu of the wind, which technically makes it a "cowmill". Also, when walking around or being attacked, the cow will often say "Moo" as if it had been typed by a player. A cow is also one of the possible NPCs players can talk to using the [[NPC Contact]] spell.

When killing cows, a [[super Cow|elite]] version may spawn (guaranteed while on a Slayer assignment), which can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense sticks]].

==Trivia==
* When the cow says "Moo", the sound of a moo can usually be heard from the speakers.
*If you attempt to talk to a cow in [[Zanaris]], it will prompt the message: "''Hmm, interesting, there appears to be a human trying to talk to me. Is it aware that cows can't talk I wonder? Maybe if I just ignore it, it might go away.''"
* If you use an item on a cow or calf a message will appear saying "The cow doesn't want that."
* There is a signpost outside of the Lumbridge cow pen that says the number of cows killed in the world the player is in.
* On [[28 August]] [[2018]], cows outside of Zanaris were temporarily replaced with [[Strawberry cow (player-owned farm teaser)|strawberry]], [[Vanilla cow (player-owned farm teaser)|vanilla]] and [[Chocolate cow (player-owned farm teaser)|chocolate cow]]s as a teaser for the upcoming [[Player-owned farm]] update. The standard cows returned to their spots when the player-owned farm was released on [[3 September]] [[2018]].
* Some cows previously had the examine text of "Beefy."
* Since the release of the [[Master slayer cape]], it has been bugged in that you are unable to use this to force a cow slayer task on a member world. Instead, you must go to a F2P world to force pick a cow task.
